blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday, Nov. 9, administered the oath of office to Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda. In a ceremony at Malacañang, Marcos formalized Zalameda’s appointment as the country’s 28th chief justice, succeeding Alexander Gesmundo. READ: Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda is new chief justice Gesmundo reached the mandatory retirement age of 70 on Nov. 6, the same day Zalameda first took his oath of office before Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen and other members of the Supreme Court (SC) en banc, formally assuming leadership of the judiciary.
